_about: Web addresses for the app on Cloudflare. Changing this file on product makes .github/workflows/infra.yml apply it. It only ever adds or points CNAME records for the names listed here; it never deletes anything and never touches mail (MX/TXT) records.
_production_deploy: true only at release B: then main deploys to production on the live database
_github_pages_retired: true only at release B, step 5: stops deploy.yml so a push can't put the old app back over the hand-over page
_sign_in: e.g. "google" or "google,email" once that provider is set up for that database
_new_groups: "on" lets anyone start a group (or a quick round) on that database's app. Live stays "" until Stage 2 (friends' beta, decided 20 Oct). The database also refuses new groups until its new_groups_open flag is on (migration 047).
_google: client_id is public (it's in every sign-in). Google's own button shows only on button_hosts, which must match the client's Authorised JavaScript origins in Google Cloud; everywhere else uses the redirect.
